name: WF0 - Welcome Message on New Lead

parameters.query: SELECT c.name as brand_name, c.phone_number_id, c.wa_access_token, bd_welcome.content as welcome_template FROM clients c LEFT JOIN brain_docs bd_welcome ON bd_welcome.client_id = c.id AND bd_welcome.doc_type = 'welcome_template' WHERE c.id = {{ $json.client_id }}
UPDATE leads SET flow_step = 'welcome', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = {{ $('Extract Lead Info').first().json.lead_id }}
